MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 27
   C. 17
   D. 31

2. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

3. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 82

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

5. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 25

6. Solve for x: x + 6 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 16
   C. 6
   D. 11

7. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

8. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

9. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 1
   C. 15
   D. 56

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

13. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 72

14. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

15. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

16. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 11

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: c² = 7² + 24²
3. c² = 49 + 576
4. c² = 625
5. c = 25
Final Answer: 25 cm
